usedFor: Shopify holds orders, and Supabase stores each “Order Cancelled” as a record through “Add A Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Add A Row To Table” in Supabase
bestTemplate.why: Cancellations land in your own table, so reporting does not depend on exports.

watchOut: “Add A Row To Table” writes to one chosen table, so match its columns to the cancelled order.
